notes: Company background: vertical search provider for financial services documentation. Heavily index-driven; current index ~420M vectors, projecting growth to 1B in 18 months.
Primary ask: replace a brittle DIY retrieval pipeline with a managed inference+embedding layer that gives predictable latency and < $0.005 avg cost/query (target ~$0.002–0.003) at production scale.

Workload details: mix of embeddings for nightly indexing + realtime reranking on top of ANN candidate sets. Typical traffic pattern: large nightly bulk ingestion (200M vectors/day peak), steady online QPS 800–2k with P99 target <= 200ms for top-K rerank path.

Model preferences: open-weights embedding models for cost + reproducibility; also evaluating hybrid path with smaller dense embeddings + lightweight cross-encoder reranker (on GPU) for precision-sensitive queries.

Architecture notes from call: want two-tier routing - cheap approximate ANN for candidate recall (<50ms), then on-GPU reranker with KV cache for hot-docs. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/caching and quantization profiles.
Security/compliance: must support EU data residency for EU customers; SOC2 compliance required; SSO via SAML 2.0; retention controls for PII (ability to opt-out of logging for certain datasets).

requirements_summary: Scale: current 420M vectors; target 1B within 12–18 months; need elastic ingestion that won't degrade online latency.
Latency: P99 end-to-end rerank path <= 200ms, median < 70ms. ANN-only path target < 50ms.
Throughput: steady QPS 800–2k; burst to 5k during product demos.
Cost: target avg cost/query $0.0025–0.003; willing to pay more for reliability on top-tier accounts.
Reliability: SLA required for Dedicated; automatic fallback to cheaper model variants during contention.
Data controls: EU residency for customer data shards; KMS integration for key management; audit logs for reranker calls.
Operational: want tooling to visualize token-level cost and per-route latency; canary deploys for reranker model updates.
